== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Rebel Commander (Japanese ESB Two-Player)|Rebel Commander]] from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=100666 source], Japanese ESB Two-Player photograph.

Crop rectangle <code>(90, 50, 680, 930)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>bb205d3317d1a7e2cf2a400393fd8780dce5698335411ad57c17489bb703eacc</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
